from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,shutil
p=Path(__file__).parent;o=p/'screen';o.mkdir(exist_ok=True);src=Path('/tmp/lis_round2_20261030/api_separate.cpp').read_text().replace('std::size_t{32768}','std::size_t{131072}').replace('const int reps=','const int reps=(mode==1||mode==2||mode==3?8:1)*');(p/'api.cpp').write_text(src)
vs={'baseline':p/'baseline/library.hpp','arrays':p/'arrays.hpp','pivot':p/'review/quartile_pivot_select.hpp','weighted':p/'review/quartile_weighted_offset.hpp','balanced':p/'review/quartile_balanced.hpp'};builds=[]
for cc,c in {'gcc':['/usr/bin/g++'],'native':['/usr/bin/g++','-march=native']}.items():
 for v,h in vs.items():
  cmd=['taskset','-c','4',*c,'-std=c++23','-O2','-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS',f'-DSOURCE="{h}"','-DVALUE_TYPE=std::int64_t','-DSTRICT_MODE=1','-DOP=0',str(p/'api.cpp'),'-o',str(o/f'{cc}-{v}')];a=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);assert a.returncode==0,a.stderr;builds.append(dict(cc=cc,variant=v,header_sha256=hashlib.sha256(h.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),command=cmd))
 shutil.copyfile(o/f'{cc}-baseline',o/f'{cc}-control');print('screen built',cc,flush=True)
(o/'builds.json').write_text(json.dumps(builds,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,shutil
p=Path(__file__).parent;o=p/'main';o.mkdir(exist_ok=True);code=(p/'baseline/main.cpp').read_text().replace('#include "Verify/current/common/fast_io.hpp"',(p/'baseline/fast_io.hpp').read_text());vs={'baseline':p/'baseline/library.hpp','pivot':p/'review/quartile_pivot_select.hpp','masked':p/'review/quartile_masked_offset.hpp'};builds=[]

 for v,h in vs.items():
  src=o/f'{v}.cpp';src.write_text('#define SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n'+h.read_text()+code);cmd=['taskset','-c','4',*c,'-std=c++23','-O2',str(src),'-o',str(o/f'{cc}-{v}')];a=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);assert a.returncode==0,a.stderr;builds.append(dict(cc=cc,variant=v,source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(h.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),command=cmd))

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,random,statistics,shutil,resource,time,hashlib
p=Path(__file__).parent;o=p/'main';off=Path('/tmp/lis_round2_20261030/official/in');vs=['baseline','control','masked'];rng=random.Random(41410955);raw=[]
cases=[('native',p/'extras/mode7_65535.in'),('native',p/'extras/mode7_500000.in'),('native',p/'extras/mode8_500000.in'),('gcc',off/'max_random_04.in'),('native',off/'max_random_04.in')]
for cc,inp in cases:
 checks=set()
 for rep in range(15):
  order=vs.copy();rng.shuffle(order)
  for v in order:
   active=o/'active';shutil.copyfile(o/f'{cc}-{v}',active);active.chmod(0o755);out=o/'active.out';before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);t=time.perf_counter_ns()
   with inp.open('rb')as fi,out.open('wb')as fo:a=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','12',str(active)],stdin=fi,stdout=fo,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
   wall=time.perf_counter_ns()-t;after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);cpu=round((after.ru_utime+after.ru_stime-before.ru_utime-before.ru_stime)*1e9);assert a.returncode==0,a.stderr;h=hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest();checks.add(h);raw.append(dict(cc=cc,case=inp.stem,rep=rep,variant=v,cpu_ns=cpu,wall_ns=wall,stdout_sha256=h))
 assert len(checks)==1
out=[]
for cc,case in sorted({(x['cc'],x['case'])for x in raw}):
 m={v:statistics.median(x['cpu_ns']for x in raw if(x['cc'],x['case'],x['variant'])==(cc,case,v))for v in vs};out.append(dict(cc=cc,case=case,median_cpu_ns=m,ratios={v:m[v]/m['baseline']for v in vs}))
(o/'confirm-raw.json').write_text(json.dumps(raw,indent=2));(o/'confirm-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2));print(json.dumps(out),flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import bisect,json,hashlib,random
p=Path(__file__).parent;o=p/'extras';o.mkdir(exist_ok=True);r=random.Random(414109);meta=[]
for n,mode in [(32,0),(65535,7),(65536,7),(65537,7),(500000,7),(500000,8),(500000,9),(500000,10)]:
 vals=[]
 for i in range(n):
  if mode==0:x=r.randrange(1000000000)
  elif mode==7:x=i%512
  elif mode==8:x=n-i if i&1 else i
  elif mode==9:x=r.randrange(1000000000)if i<256 else 1000000000+i
  else:x=r.randrange(1000000000)if i<n//2 else -i
  vals.append(x)
 f=o/f'mode{mode}_{n}.in';f.write_text(str(n)+'\n'+' '.join(map(str,vals))+'\n');tails=[]
 for x in vals:
  i=bisect.bisect_left(tails,x)
  if i==len(tails):tails.append(x)
  else:tails[i]=x
 meta.append(dict(path=str(f),name=f.stem,n=n,mode=mode,length=len(tails),sha256=hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),origin='独立作成。mode9/10は公式問題の値域外も含む、library APIとして有効な整数列。'))
(o/'metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2));print('extras',len(meta))
